entities.name: Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Sánchez–Pizjuán Muñoz was a Spanish lawyer. He was the president of Sevilla FC from 1932 to 1941, and again from 1948 to 1956. Under his presidency, the club reached La Liga and won the national cup twice, while the land was brought for the stadium that bears his name.
